coverage_claim: WM-ECO-038 covers one governed Equity / Security Holding as a source-qualified position binding a holder capacity, security and account or register context to balance observations, lots, rights, restrictions, changes, corporate-action views, reporting, provenance, access and loss-aware projections. Instrument-class, jurisdiction, legal-title, accounting, tax, licensing, implementation-conformance and independent-review questions remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The model owns a source-qualified holding position, balance assertions, position-scoped rights and restrictions and immutable correction lineage. Security, party, ownership determination, account, custody, trade, settlement, payment, ledger, valuation, corporate action, tax, filing and records remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: The aggregate binds a holder capacity, security and account or register context to source-qualified balances without becoming the instrument, account or owner.
The former Credit / Security parent is marked for split, so it cannot safely supply inheritance semantics or cascade authority.
The instrument owns contractual or issuance terms while a holding identifies a holder-capacity position and quantity in that instrument at time.
A consolidated view must retain every source position, custody chain, capacity, unit, knowledge cut and reconciliation difference.

decisions.concept: Legal, registered, beneficial and economic interests
decisions.rationale: The holder of record, nominee, custodian, beneficial owner and economic interest holder may differ and require separately sourced authority.

decisions.concept: Quantity, percentage, voting power and value
decisions.rationale: Position quantity does not by itself establish ownership percentage, voting power, cost, carrying amount, market value or regulatory exposure.
Order, trade, allocation, settlement, payment, book entry and effective ownership have different identities, states and applicable time rules.
Settled, available, blocked, pledged, lent, borrowed, pending and entitled quantities cannot be collapsed without losing operational and legal meaning.
The holding supplies a dated quantity and capacity view while event, eligibility rule, entitlement, election, instruction, movement, payment and tax outcomes remain external records.
Threshold filings and shareholder-identification reports are purpose and jurisdiction specific and may omit interests or intermediary-chain detail.
ISIN, CFI, FIGI, FIBO and ISO 20022 serve different identity, classification, ontology and message purposes and do not define one universal storage interface.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without acquiring new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-038 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Boundary hold: the aggregate owns source-qualified holding positions and correction lineage while instrument, ownership, account, custody, transaction, corporate-action, filing and records masters remain external.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-038 EXTEND WM-ECO-005 remains a candidate relation because the former Credit / Security category is marked for split.
Position-class hold: equity, debt-security, fund-share, depositary-receipt, direct, indirect, omnibus, segregated, nominee, lending, repo and collateral positions need separate validation profiles.

Jurisdiction hold: property rights, intermediated holding systems, settlement finality, shareholder identity, beneficial ownership, voting, tax, insolvency and disclosure depend on jurisdiction and security class.
Accounting hold: IFRS pages establish boundaries but licensed text, jurisdictional adoption and entity-specific conclusions remain outside this draft; no full IFRS conformance is claimed.
Identity hold: source position keys, composite identities, cross-custodian consolidation, account transfers, splits and merges require master-specific reconciliation profiles.
Capacity hold: legal owner, registered holder, beneficial owner, economic interest holder, nominee, custodian and investment manager remain separately sourced roles.
Balance hold: settled, available, blocked, pledged, lent, borrowed, pending, entitled and disputed quantities remain separately typed and timed.
Corporate-action hold: eligibility, entitlement, election, instruction acceptance, movement, payment and tax outcomes require exact event and market profiles.
FIBO release hold: master/latest ontology pages are development artifacts; implementation conformance requires an exact production release and licensing review.
Interoperability hold: every ISO, FIGI, FIBO, regulatory, API, document or message projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and semantic-loss declarations.
Review hold: securities operations, custody, investment, corporate actions, legal, accounting, tax, risk, data, security, records and independent external review are outstanding.
deferred_research: Approve or reject the WM-ECO-005 candidate relation after Credit, Security Instrument, Debt Instrument, Equity Instrument and Holding boundaries are normalized.
Create independently validated equity, debt-security, fund-share, depositary-receipt, direct, indirect, omnibus, segregated, nominee, lending, repo and collateral-position profiles.
Benchmark source-position identity, account and custody mapping, balance-bucket reconciliation, lot allocation, corporate-action eligibility and cross-system consolidation.
Validate jurisdiction, legal-title, beneficial-ownership, voting, disclosure, tax, insolvency, settlement-finality, privacy and retention rules.

Pin exact external releases and licensing conditions and obtain independent securities, custody, investment, legal, accounting, tax, data and records review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
